explanation.text:
Plan simulation summary
The plan is a simulation, so no money has actually moved (F1). It proposes you pay USD 990.00 to the food supplier on 2026‑11‑10, which includes a USD 10.00 discount (F3). According to the model you would keep a net benefit of USD 3.70 after accounting for the discount and an early‑payment cost of USD 6.30 (F4). To cover the payment you would need to reserve USD 990.00 from verified funds (F5), and you still need to accept the offer and authorize the payment (F6).
